authority: TD_R03 §5: no F1 may be created solely because routes coexist, have opposite signs/directions, share source/target/mediator/stratum, overlap in geography/time, derive from the same V554 affordance, have similar labels, or appear together in runtime context. These may be candidate premises a future rule examines; they are never the rule itself.
TD_R03 §6: no complete governed V556 interaction-rule authority was found in the audited architecture. Therefore F1 is required as a family but the first implementation tranche may be valid-empty.
TD_R03 gate G14: no F1 inferred from coexistence/sign/common source/target/stratum/geography/time
interaction_relation.what_the_previous_tranche_did: minted exactly the three relation kinds TD_R03 §5 forbids as constituting an F1: coexistence, shared mediator/channel, and appearing together. This was not a smuggled scalar; it was an inverted non-inference law.
interaction_relation.what_was_done_instead_of_fabricating: the three names are retained only as non-inferable premises and are refused in any authorable enum; interaction_relation_canary_rule() refuses with the reason; the family appears in unfilled_families
interaction_relation.required_to_populate: a governed V556_PRESSURE_INTERACTION_RULE_REGISTRY (or an interaction namespace in a unified topology registry) binding the sixteen items TD_R03 §6 requires, including an authorized relation kind, eligible V555 route signatures, exact participant roles, allowed cardinality with dyadic versus genuinely n-ary, ordering significance, directionality/symmetry semantics, and required upstream authorities

topology.cardinality_truthfulness: the previous tranche declared UNBOUNDED while only n=2 was realizable, which the review probe P6b demonstrated by returning INVALID_PARTICIPANT_SET for a three-participant request. The maximum is now the truthful dyadic 2, and the seam refuses a third participant.
topology.shared_channel_dyad_removed: the previously mandatory shared_structural_channel_ref is gone, so the shape is no longer structurally a shared-channel dyad

f2_claim.label: NOT_AN_F2_ATTRACTOR_PREREQUISITE_TOPOLOGY__NO_F2_GRAIN_CLAIMED
f2_claim.td_r03_f2_grain_not_materialized: TD_R03 §8 F2 is a motif over 1..n role-qualified V555 route refs plus 0..n V556 F1 relation refs, with conditions, lawful feedback/recurrence premises and destabilizer/escape possibilities, plus governed path/order/cycle roles and actor-history requirement predicate IDs. The retained canary materializes none of the F1 or feedback or destabilizer grain and does not claim to.
f2_claim.f2_authority_status: TD_R03 §8 also records that no complete governed attractor-prerequisite rule authority was found, so the first F2 tranche may also be valid-empty

payload_binding.mechanism: validate_payload_against_participants refuses a payload endpoint ref that is not among the governed participants' v555_route_identity_ref identifiers, matching on either M3-committed identifier (object_id = route_id, content_hash = semantic_hash(route))
payload_binding.reasoning: TD_R03 requires exact V555 route refs by reference; a payload endpoint free of the governed participants would be a fabricated route identity

positive_core_preserved.reason: exact active V556 rule/result-schema authority and exact V555 participant seam verified
